verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is fundamentally an API product with extensive documented REST endpoints (web, news, image, local, summarizer, LLM Context endpoint built specifically for agents/RAG), an official MCP server for agent integration, and llms.txt discoverability confirmed by probe. Minor caveat: no OpenAPI/swagger spec found and community notes ToS ambiguity around AI inference use requiring a specific plan, but the API is clearly documented and agent-oriented.
